parsed.post: Discarding 131072 batch: 0.8935 vs best 0.8850. More steps hurt. Next: clean control with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' on current depth6/warmup0.05/262k config. If bpb jumps, all 0-10 numbers are eval-leakage-contaminated and we should re-baseline.
parsed.description: Discard the failed 131072 batch experiment and test clean training shards excluding EVAL_SHARD=10 on the current depth6/warmup0.05/262144 config.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so current val_bpb gains may be validation-data contamination. Please treat all 0-10 results as suspect and re-baseline the team on clean shards if confirmed.
